# vscode theme inputs

Source: https://github.com/dinbtechit/vscode-theme

Commit: `3704464217ce81fe3742b9c2407de0ba34482d5e`

License: BSD-2-Clause (`LICENSE.md`). Exact upstream bytes and hashes are recorded in assets.tsv.

Original author fields are preserved. If absent, use upstream vendor credit: dinbtechit.

- `themes/vscode_dark_modern.theme.json`: Code Dark Modern (`vscode-dark-modern`); old names: VSCode Dark Modern
- `themes/vscode_dark.theme.json`: Code Dark (`vscode-dark`); old names: VSCode Dark
- `themes/vscode_light.theme.json`: Code Light (`vscode-light`); old names: VSCode Light Modern
